work.author: Leo PP. Decimus Secundus
work.description: Full allocution Plures ab aliquo tempore read from Venerabiles fratres LF61394 through the complete cardinal publications/creations and actual Trinitarian ending LF61547–61548. Whole native images leaf431/432 and every native row were inspected: the address begins below its separate descriptive title/date; body crosses apo-/stolicae at LF61437/61449 and fieret/semel at LF61512/61516 without alien notes or displaced clauses. Leo XII is the shared running header LF61443; the speaker explicitly publishes two cardinals reserved in pectore and creates two others by his apostolic authority. No conflicting or quoted issuer. Exact publishing-furniture omissions are qualified below; the complete substantive speech is retained. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
